node.statement: Concrete exact obstruction: let B=C oplus C with complementary central projections q_1=(1,0), q_2=(0,1), and let A_R=M_2(C) oplus M_2(C) with P_1=(I_2,0), P_2=(0,I_2).  Define the two diagonal corner maps by lambda mapsto (lambda I_2,0) and mu mapsto (0,mu I_2), and the two cross-corner maps as the unique maps 0->0.  At every matrix amplification these four fixed maps preserve involution and compressed products exactly, send the diagonal source units exactly to P_1,P_2, and satisfy the two-sided norm inequalities with defect 0; also P_1,P_2 are exact complementary projections.  Hence they satisfy def-four-corner-merging-datum with rho=0, but the diagonal maps are not onto M_2(C), and dim_C(B)=2 whereas dim_C(A_R)=8, so no bijection B->A_R exists.
